verses.1: And yet, listen to me, Elohim. Listen to all my words.
verses.2: Please, I would like to open my mouth and speak to you in a different way.
verses.3: My words are true, and the thoughts in my mouth are pure.
verses.4: The Spirit of God created me, and the breath of life gave me life.
verses.5: If you can bring me back to my former state, then I will stand before you again.
verses.6: I too, like you, have been freed from the bondage of sin. I too am free now.
verses.7: See, My truth will not be rejected by you; and My punishment will not be harmful to you.
verses.8: But you said to me, “And a voice of silence was heard.”
verses.9: I am innocent of any sin; I am not guilty of anything wrongful.
verses.10: They also gave me orders to consider me as an enemy to them.
verses.11: May my feet be placed in the sand, so that all my limbs may be preserved.
verses.12: And this is not right. I will not answer you, for the Lord will increase in number among men.
verses.13: Why should there be conflicts with him? For all his words do not answer.
verses.14: For in one instance, one can speak; but in two instances, it cannot be done.
verses.15: In the dream, during the night, a nightmare falls upon people, causing them to sleep on their beds.
verses.16: Then, people will discover that they are all equal in their nature.
verses.17: To remove a person from their actions and character is to cover them with a veil.
verses.18: His soul is separated from me; his life is spent in suffering.
verses.19: And he lay in pain on his bed, with most of his body covered in wounds.
verses.20: And his life became like bread; his soul ate away at him.
verses.21: He could see through his own words, but he couldn’t see his own actions.
verses.22: And his soul and his life were brought close to destruction.
verses.23: If there’s a prophet among me, let him say to a person who is righteous:
verses.24: And he took him by the hand and said, “Save him from the fire of hell. I have found a camel.”
verses.25: His words are like those of a child who returns to his childhood.
verses.26: He will seek out the Lord, and He will accept him. He will see His face with joy, and he will sit in the righteousness of His ways.
verses.27: He punished the people, and he said, “My sin is great; I have been punished, but I will not turn away from my sins.”
verses.28: His soul was freed from suffering, and his life became bright and beautiful.
verses.29: All of these things will happen several times, along with the Lord.
verses.30: To restore his soul from the darkness to the light of life.
verses.31: The one who listens to my words will be blessed, and I will speak.
verses.32: If there is any error in my words, then I ask for your forgiveness. I truly desire to be just with you.
verses.33: If you truly understand me, then you will be wise.
